*This is where I'm reading any necessary packages into the current session.*

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

*I'm using read_csv to read in the data in the form of a tibble. Then, I'm using str() to check the structure of the data and make sure that all of the data was read in as the right type.*

```{r}
housing_data <- read_csv('MELBOURNE_HOUSE_PRICES_LESS.csv')
str(housing_data)
```

*Making contingency tables.*

```{r}
#One way table for the Method category
table(housing_data$Method)

#One way table for the Type category
table(housing_data$Type)

#One way table for the Regionname category
table(housing_data$Regionname)

#Two way table for both Method and Type
table(housing_data$Method, housing_data$Type)

#Two way table for both Method and Regionname
table(housing_data$Method, housing_data$Regionname)

#Two way table for both Type and Regionname
table(housing_data$Type, housing_data$Regionname)
```

*Finding numeric summaries.*

```{r}
#Finding the mean, median, and sd Price values across the Regionname cateogry
housing_data |>
  group_by(Regionname) |>
  drop_na(Regionname) |>
  summarize(mean_price = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE), median_price = median(Price, na.rm = TRUE), sd_price = sd(Price, na.rm = TRUE))

#Finding the mean and sd Propertycount values across the CouncilArea category
housing_data |>
  group_by(CouncilArea) |>
  drop_na(CouncilArea) |>
  summarize(mean_size = mean(Propertycount, na.rm = TRUE), median_size = median(Propertycount, na.rm = TRUE), sd_size = sd(Propertycount, na.rm = TRUE))
```

*Adding stacked bar chart for the **Regionname** and **CouncilArea** categories.*

```{r}
stacked_barplot <- ggplot(data = housing_data |>
                           drop_na(Regionname, CouncilArea), aes(x = Regionname, fill = CouncilArea))
stacked_barplot + geom_bar() +
  labs(x = 'Name of General Region')
```

*Adding a histogram for the **Rooms** variable.*

```{r}
smoothed_histogram <- ggplot(housing_data |>
                               drop_na(Rooms), aes(x = Rooms))
smoothed_histogram + geom_density()
```

*Adding a boxplot that compares **Price** and **Type**.*

```{r}
price_boxplot <- ggplot(housing_data |>
                          drop_na(Price, Type))
price_boxplot + geom_boxplot(aes(x = Type, y = Price, fill = Type))
```

*Adding a scatterplot that compares **Price** and **Distance**.*

```{r}
price_scatterplot <- ggplot(housing_data |>
                              drop_na(Price, Distance), aes(x = Price, y = Distance))
price_scatterplot + geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm)
```

*Making a side-by-side faceted bar plot of the **Type**, **Method**, and **Regionname** variables.*

```{r}
ggplot(data = housing_data |>
         drop_na(Type, Method, Regionname), aes(x = Method, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge') +
  labs(x = 'Method') +
  scale_fill_discrete('Type') +
  facet_wrap(~ Regionname)
```

*Adding a heatmap for the **Regionname**, **Type, and Distance** variables.*

```{r}
ggplot(data = housing_data |>
         drop_na(Regionname, Type, Distance), aes(x = Type, y = Regionname, fill = Distance)) +
  geom_tile(color = 'lightblue') +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = 'lightblue', high = 'darkblue') +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = 'Type', y = 'Regionname')
  
```
